snippet.title: Fernhoof Grove - Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Patreon as a free member to be notified when the playtest is out! https://www.patreon.com/cw/miaumigames
How to Playtest: https://www.patreon.com/miaumigames/posts/how-to-playtest-160129715

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4406760/Fernhoof_Grove_Riding_Academy/

Enroll in Fernhoof Academy to become a professional horse trainer. Own and care for horses, design training routines, and improve a horse’s skills through precise riding. Learn equine theory, pass riding exams, and compete in show jumping and cross country on your way to graduation.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/f5XW4CHebT
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fernhoofgrove/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fernhoofgrove

Music: https://www.purple-planet.com
